question: Should OpenClaw accept this narrow `currentTokenCount` assemble contract and token-budget helper SDK exports now, or fold token budgeting into the broader assemble-metadata RFC at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/82137?
rationale: The PR expands a plugin-facing API while a broader context-engine assemble metadata RFC remains open, so automation cannot decide the stable public contract shape.

options.title: Accept narrow contract after proof
options.body: Approve the `currentTokenCount` API direction, then require SDK baseline regeneration and live long-session/context-engine proof before merge.

options.title: Fold into RFC
options.body: Pause this PR and handle token budgeting together with the broader provenance/internal-event assemble metadata design.

options.title: Keep private for now
options.body: Avoid new SDK exports until maintainers settle the permanent context-engine metadata and compatibility plan.

recommendation.title: Accept narrow contract after proof
recommendation.body: Approve the `currentTokenCount` API direction, then require SDK baseline regeneration and live long-session/context-engine proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned and have the clearest recent history on context-engine budgeting and assemble paths.
